newsitem.title: CANADA: Gulf sees mailing CS offer Monday.
newsitem.headline: Gulf sees mailing CS offer Monday.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources Ltd expects to receive takeover target CS Resources Ltd's shareholder list on Monday and hopes to mail its takeover offer immediately after, a Gulf spokesman said on Friday.
"The normal course of events would be day 10 (after Gulf announced its bid intentions) and we'll try to mail that day," Gulf's Dennis Martin said.
Gulf said last week it intended to offer CS shareholders C$14.25 in cash, subject to a maximum of C$100 million, or 1.1539 of a Gulf share for each CS share in a C$413 million deal.
CS meanwhile has said it expected to be in a position to announce a strategic alliance deal as an alternative to Gulf's offer.
The company has said it could say little about the Gulf bid until it received the formal offer.

CS shares closed up 0.10 on Friday to 14.75 in moderate volume of 166,360 shares. Gulf ended the Toronto Stock Exchange session down 0.15 to 11.70, placing the share swap value of its bid at C$13.50 for each CS share.
